A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SSL study with vision foundation models. The main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-C are available and support reliable comparison; the longer bibliography in v3 shifts appendix pagination.

before.justification: v2 reports original classification experiments, ensemble-scaling results, and supplementary analyses, including Table 3, Figure 5, and Appendices B-C.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark experiments, ensemble analyses, and quantitative appendix results.

M1.justification: V-PET retains the same PEFT training, one-hot pseudo-label generation, averaging across models, and single-round self-training procedure. Algorithm 1 and the seven-validator hyperparameter-selection method are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate DTD, SUN397, Resisc45, Retinopathy, Clevr-C, and KITTI. The CIFAR-10/100 and Food-101 linear-probing comparisons in Table 1 are also retained, with no added dataset or test scenario.

E2.justification: Tables 3 and 6 retain the same labeled-only, FixMatch, FlexMatch, SoftMatch, FineSSL, ST, and PET comparators. Ensemble-strategy and hyperparameter-tuning comparisons also retain their comparator sets; the newly cited works are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: The reported label regimes, validation/test sizes, model configurations, Top-1 accuracy metric, and training/search settings remain unchanged in Sections 3-6 and Tables 2, 4, and 5. Scaling and appendix-analysis protocols are also retained.

E4.justification: Section 6.2 retains the same ensemble-scaling and aggregation-strategy analyses. Appendices B.4-B.7 retain the classification-head, labeled-only initialization, weaker-VFM ensembling, and hyperparameter-tuning studies without additional analyses.

E5.justification: Section 6.2 still reports five runs with distinct random pseudo-label sets. Figure 5's error bars and Table 11's mean and standard deviation reporting remain unchanged, with no new run-count or statistical-testing information.

E6.justification: The matched numerical results, rankings, plotted trends, and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 6 retains V-PET averages of 60.53% for CLIP/LoRA and 61.24% for DINOv2/LoRA.

T1.justification: The SSL formulation, pseudo-label and ensemble equations, and Appendix C's validator definitions and ranking formulation are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about labeled-only PEFT, complementary pseudo-labels, V-PET's effectiveness, and the benchmark and tuning protocol. The contribution scope and novelty positioning are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the hypothesis about noisy SSL updates harming pretrained generalizability, the explanations involving prediction diversity and confidence-scale mismatch, and the discussion of diminishing ensemble returns. The classification focus and applicability qualifications are unchanged.

D1.justification: The code-access statement, hardware/software details, and hyperparameter search spaces remain unchanged. The new acknowledgment credits NSF funding and Ohio Supercomputer Center resources but adds no technical setting or reproducibility instruction.

R1.justification: v3 adds six background references: BioCLIP 2, AVA-Bench, Fine-tuning Is Fine, If Calibrated, Holistic Transfer, Visual Instance-Aware Prompt Tuning, and OT-VP. These supplement existing passages without substantively changing positioning. v2 reference 44 is updated to its published form as v3 reference 47, rather than representing a new cited work.

P1.justification: v3 adds an Acknowledgment after the conclusion, changes several cross-references from 'appendix' to 'section,' and updates bibliographic metadata. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment occupies additional space above References on page 10, and the expanded bibliography reflows the back matter. Figures 1-6 and Tables 1-12 retain their designs, ordering, and visual content; caption changes are limited to cross-reference wording.

improvement.justification: v3 adds background citations, updates a publication reference, and acknowledges funding and computing support. The methods, experimental evidence, mathematical exposition, interpretations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including the appendices. These limited attribution and presentation edits do not meaningfully strengthen or weaken the paper's overall rigor or clarity.
